fullTextZH: 我要说说我小时候最喜欢的工作
fullTextEN: I want to talk about my favorite job when I was a child.
And the job I liked the least.

fullTextZH: 有一天我和我的朋友去麦当劳
fullTextEN: One day, my friend and I went to McDonald's.

fullTextZH: 我们看有一个小朋友的生日
麦当劳的服务员给他生日蛋糕
fullTextEN: The McDonald's server gave him a birthday cake.

fullTextZH: 麦当劳的服务员可以唱歌

fullTextEN: This job is not tiring and very fun.

fullTextZH: 所以我想当麦当劳的服务员
fullTextEN: So I want to be a McDonald's server.

fullTextZH: 我最喜欢的工作是开洒水车
fullTextEN: My favorite job is driving a water truck.
I don't know about your country
When I was young, I lived in Shenzhen

fullTextZH: 深圳是一个很大的城市
fullTextEN: Shenzhen is a very big city

fullTextZH: 如果我们想要深圳很干净很漂亮
fullTextEN: If we want Shenzhen to be clean and beautiful
then we need to drive the water truck

fullTextZH: 如果我和我的朋友看到洒水车
fullTextEN: If my friends and I saw a water truck

fullTextZH: 那个时候我看到洒水车
fullTextEN: At that time, when I saw the water truck
I thought it was so cool
I feel that driving a water truck is not tiring
And kids are afraid of you

fullTextZH: 我最喜欢的工作是音乐老师
fullTextEN: My favorite job is being a music teacher

fullTextZH: 我喜欢和小朋友一起唱歌

fullTextEN: I want to learn to play the piano.
I was five years old at that time.
Zhi Fei, you sing very well.
I want to be a music teacher.

fullTextZH: 他们可能请另一个人照顾他们的孩子
fullTextEN: They might hire another person to take care of their children.
I like to play with children.

fullTextZH: 我可以跟他们一起唱歌看电视
fullTextEN: I can sing and watch TV with them.

fullTextZH: 我可以跟他们一起看书
fullTextEN: I can read books with them.

fullTextZH: 不累 好玩 和人说话的工作
fullTextEN: Not tiring, fun, and jobs where you talk to people.

fullTextZH: 那我最不喜欢什么工作呢
fullTextEN: So what job do I dislike the most?

fullTextZH: 我最不喜欢当公共汽车的售票员
fullTextEN: I dislike being a bus conductor the most.

fullTextZH: 还有公共汽车售票员吗
现在很少公共汽车售票员
fullTextEN: There are very few bus conductors now.
Because you can buy tickets yourself.

fullTextZH: 为什么我不喜欢当公共汽车售票员呢
fullTextEN: Why don't I like being a bus conductor?
I went to take the bus,
There were always so many people,

fullTextZH: 我看到公共汽车售票员

fullTextEN: I saw they were very hot.
I think they are too tired.

fullTextZH: 我以后不要当公共汽车售票员
fullTextEN: I don't want to be a bus conductor in the future.

fullTextZH: 我最不喜欢的工作是杀鱼的人
fullTextEN: My least favorite job is being a fish killer.
You know when you go to buy fish.
You eat fish, you go to buy fish.

fullTextZH: 那有一个人的工作是杀鱼
fullTextEN: There is a person whose job is to kill fish.

fullTextZH: 我跟我的妈妈一起去买鱼
fullTextEN: I went to buy fish with my mom.
The place where they kill fish is very smelly
I don't like very smelly places

fullTextZH: 所以我想我以后不要当杀鱼的人
fullTextEN: So I think I don't want to be a fish killer in the future
So I didn't like it when I was a child
Very tiring jobs that require standing

fullTextZH: 也不喜欢在很臭的地方工作
fullTextEN: I also don't like working in very smelly places

fullTextZH: 你小时候最喜欢什么工作
fullTextEN: What was your favorite job when you were a child?

fullTextZH: 你最不喜欢什么工作呢
fullTextEN: What job do you dislike the most?
